semantics: All eight tables are explicit original UTF-8 CSVs; header-only means explicitly empty, absent table is rejected.
Dates require UTC offsets and whole-minute timestamps. Half-open room/person intervals; no implicit timezone/DST conversion.
Money is declared integer minor units and exact BigInt arithmetic; one explicit ISO currency per session. No exchange conversion.

Completed sessions compare booked, actual and explicitly declared booked|actual|package billing. Quantization uses declared whole-minute increment, round up duration once then half-up monetary result once per base/overtime component.

booked: base booked duration at hourly rate; overtime only actual duration beyond booked. actual: base min(actual,booked), overtime beyond booked. package: declared package amount plus overtime beyond booked.
Cancelled/no-show sessions get a manual-policy attention; no cancellation charge or refund calculated. Scheduled/in-progress remain unfinished.
One optional label payer per session: all, booked (base only), or fixed (cap allocated base first then overtime); residual belongs to artist. Allocation source references required.
Observed base/overtime invoice lines compare to expected component and payer; explicit discount/fee/tax/other are visible separate reviewed adjustments and never invented tax calculations.
Payment kinds receipt/refund are positive source amounts, net receipts remain separate from invoiced amounts; no payment action occurs.

Crew assignments statuses assigned|seen|cant_make_it|covered|declined|outside. A cant_make_it assignment remains a known unavailable obligation; covered requires accepted replacement assignment in same session/role. Outside engineer counts only declared engineer role; house assistant requirement stays explicit in crew_rules.
Report signed status needs named signer/offset timestamp/reference. Missing report stays attention. Decisions annotate exact source-bound attention and never erase calculated differences.
Full historical originals/editions/review corrections survive JSON and native continuation. Actual customer data is absent from production seed.

Optional explicit PO columns preserve session PO precedence over a label deal PO. Observed label-line mismatch and one invoice containing distinct observed POs become attention; no invoice is changed or sent.
sourceBoundary: Independent companion study of studio-declared exports, preserving the original source and workflow responsibilities.
